title: 春江花月夜
author: 张若虚
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE full-bleed 9:16 portrait watercolor illustration, a final artwork for a premium Chinese poetry reader, not a mockup. Poem: 春江花月夜 by 张若虚. Scene: a broad spring river meeting the distant sea under a single softly luminous full moon, flowering trees on the riverbank with petals softly silvered by moonlight, a tiny solitary traditional wooden boat suggesting a traveler far from home. Express the quiet vastness of moonlit water and tender longing, no literal fantasy figures. Style: refined Chinese ink and delicate translucent watercolor on warm ivory xuan paper, restrained pale celadon, blue-grey, warm cream, natural brush granulation, subtle paper fibers, gentle hand-painted detail. CRITICAL PAGE COMPOSITION: the river, moon, flowering bank and tiny boat occupy ONLY the upper quarter (top 25–28%) of the tall paper. Moon above the horizon within that upper scene. Painted shapes and reflections dissolve gradually into ivory mist by 32% of page height. Keep the entire central and lower 65% as almost blank warm ivory paper for a long poem to be overlaid later. Do not place boat, moon, flowers or other subjects in the center or lower part. Full bleed paper to all four edges; no rectangle, picture frame, border, lower decorations, high-contrast dark wash, modern objects, text, calligraphy, seal, watermark, logo or UI. A lyrical landscape with credible Tang-era boat and natural atmosphere, not a generic mountain panorama.
visualReview: Observed generated image: flowering bank at upper left, one moon above a broad river and one small boat at upper right. Scene dissolves by approximately 30% height; lower warm ivory paper is clear for long-poem text. No written text, frame, watermark or modern objects visible. Matches restrained watercolor series.
